description: The line plot, titled "Whisper fine-tuning, type = tiny," illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) over six epochs for various fine-tuning configurations of the Whisper model with the "tiny" architecture. The x-axis represents the epoch, ranging from 0 to 6 in integer steps, while the y-axis shows the WER, which decreases from approximately 69 to below 35. The legend identifies six different configurations, each represented by a distinct line style and marker: "tiny AdaLoRA_int4" (solid line with circle markers), "tiny AdaLoRA_int8" (solid line with square markers), "tiny int4" (dashed line with circle markers), "tiny int8" (dashed line with square markers), and "tiny full" (dotted line with triangle markers). All lines exhibit a general downward trend, indicating improvement in WER as training progresses. At epoch 0, the "tiny AdaLoRA_int4" configuration starts with the highest WER, around 69, while "tiny full" starts at approximately 29. By epoch 6, the "tiny AdaLoRA_int4" line stabilizes at a WER of about 40, while the "tiny full" line reaches its lowest point at approximately 22. The "tiny AdaLoRA_int8" configuration shows a similar trend to "tiny AdaLoRA_int4" but with a slightly lower WER, ending at around 37. The "tiny int4" and "tiny int8" configurations start with WERs around 60 and 50, respectively, and both decrease to approximately 38 and 36 by epoch 6. The "tiny full" configuration consistently shows the lowest WER across all epochs, indicating superior performance compared to the other methods.
